recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated studio portrait of a seated figure in distressed denim, featuring a clean horizontal typographic lockup positioned in the upper-left negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the arm leads the eye from the text to the subject's face.
The high-contrast lighting on the skin creates a sharp silhouette against the dark grey background.
The tactile texture of the distressed denim balances the smooth, flat background and skin tones.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, seated and angled toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast highlight on the shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the text in the upper left, follows the arm down to the denim texture, and curves back up to the face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark grey negative space in the upper left quadrant to accommodate display text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and mid-grey background tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white highlights on skin and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Desaturated slate blue for secondary text elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation overall; high value contrast between skin highlights and deep shadows.

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in negative space, not touching the subject

composition.position: Immediately following display text on the same baseline

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with color differentiation for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and sharp vertices.
Modern geometric feel with excellent legibility at wide tracking.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric properties.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic studio portrait of a person seated on the floor, side profile, wearing distressed denim jeans. Use low-key lighting to create highlights on the shoulder and face against a dark grey background. Ensure the upper left quadrant is empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in a single horizontal line in the upper left. Use a bold geometric sans-serif font in all caps with wide tracking. The first word should be white, the second word should be a desaturated slate blue.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to feel airy?
Is the color of the second word a muted blue rather than vibrant?
Does the subject's arm create a leading line?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the seated pose.
Ensure the denim texture looks realistic and tactile.
Verify the text is legible against the background.
Confirm the monochrome-to-blue color balance is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio lighting + Distressed texture + Geometric Sans (Wide Tracking) + Asymmetrical Composition.
